description: Save a named crew of workers to book together (owner or office). Give crew_id to rename it or replace its workers. lead_person_id marks the crew lead (a current member; they do not have to be in person_ids). Use the crew_id on visits.create, visits.assign or schedule.findTime. Shop roles are owner, office, lead and field.

lead_person_id.description: The crew lead. Omit to leave the current lead unchanged on an update, or none on a new crew. Null clears it.

name: crews_save
